name: Crowding levels
sentence: How many crowding levels proseg sorts spots into, each with its own background amount. Few: crowded spots share a level with sparser ones. Many: the most crowded get their own, and proseg counts less RNA.
info: Made-up cells, started from cells only. This cell and its neighbour press together: a 4 µm band on their border holds both cells' RNA. Each panel: the middle of 27 copies; other settings at defaults. On real 500 µm squares, 8 levels instead of 5 gave 17 % fewer pink dots, and proseg counted 9 to 10 % less RNA for the cells. 3 levels: 21 % more pink dots, 9 % more RNA.
keyNoneTip: RNA no cell's count keeps: proseg reads it as background. Inside this cell, most is its own RNA of genes its count keeps less than a fifth of: about 50 such dots at 3, 100 at 5, 170 at 8.
statTip: Pink: dots of a neighbour's RNA this cell's count keeps. Own: this cell's own RNA in proseg's count, each dot weighed by the share of its gene the count keeps. From iteration 205 on, both are means over every 5th iteration since then: a single frame's pink can jump by 10 to 20.
